implementation_statement: No security policies existed before this engagement. POL-02 (P06), which includes the program governance rules of the written information security program, was approved 2026-08-28 and takes effect 2026-09-01. A one-page onboarding and offboarding checklist for staff and contractor tutors is due 2026-09-30.

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; scheduling platform vendor; MSP
implementation_statement: The Director of Tutoring creates tutoring platform accounts for tutors; the Enrollment and Billing Coordinator creates scheduling platform accounts; the MSP creates suite and device accounts. Gap: contractor tutor offboarding is ad hoc. Three former contractor tutors still had platform accounts on 2026-07-15 (disabled that day), and there is no periodic account review.
evidence: Platform user list; scheduling platform user list; suite user export; contractor roster

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: The platform limits tutors to the students assigned to them; parents see only their own children. Gap: the shared drive "Student files" folder is open to all staff and Lead Tutors, and district roster spreadsheets are emailed to every contractor tutor in the program instead of each tutor seeing only assigned students in the platform.
evidence: Platform role settings; shared-drive permission report

implementation_statement: Staff have no local administrator rights on company devices (MSP policy). Gap: the Director of Tutoring and all 3 Lead Tutors hold platform administrator roles; only one administrator and one backup are needed.
evidence: MSP endpoint policy; platform role list

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; scheduling platform vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: Each SaaS service locks or throttles sign-in after repeated failures (vendor default settings, confirmed in vendor documentation).

Company laptops lock after 15 minutes idle (MSP policy). Gap: the front-desk desktop has no lock because several people use it, and student tablets run in kiosk mode without a lock (no student data stored).

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: The platform ends idle tutor sessions after 30 minutes; the suite uses the vendor's session controls.

Staff and contractor tutors reach the SaaS services over the internet with TLS. The MSP reaches company devices through its remote management agent. Gap: the company has no evidence of how the MSP protects that tool or who at the MSP can use it.
Staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a password known only to staff. Gap: the student and guest Wi-Fi is on the same network segment as staff laptops, and its password is posted at the front desk.

Contractor tutors use their own computers (SYS-07) for online sessions and receive district roster spreadsheets by email. No rules exist today. POL-02 B.9 (approved 2026-08-28) sets minimum device rules (supported operating system, screen lock, device encryption, no downloads of student files) and ends roster emails; contractor attestations due 2026-09-30.

Tutors complete child-safety training before working with students. There is no security or privacy training and no phishing awareness. Annual training with phishing simulations for staff and contractor tutors starts 2026-10.

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; productivity suite vendor; scheduling platform vendor
implementation_statement: Each SaaS service records sign-ins and administrative actions; the platform also logs record views and exports.

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Nobody reviews logs today. A monthly review of suite sign-in alerts, platform exports, and administrator actions, using a one-page checklist, starts 2026-10.
First independent control assessment held 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-05 (P07). POL-02 A.6 requires one every year.
No inventory of devices, SaaS services, or places where children's information is stored. A one-page inventory (POL-04 4.4) is due 2026-10-31.
No contingency plan. A short plan built from the BIA (P05), with downtime steps for online sessions and a hurricane checklist, is due 2026-11-30.
The suite backup has never been restore-tested and the platform data has never been exported. First restore test due 2026-09-30, then quarterly.
evidence: MSP confirmation that no test record exists

provider_if_inherited: MSP; tutoring platform vendor; scheduling platform vendor
implementation_statement: The MSP backs up suite email and the shared drive nightly to a SaaS backup service with 30 days of versions. The platform and scheduling vendors back up their own services. Gaps: one MSP administrator account without MFA can delete the backups; versions are not immutable; the company holds no copy of platform or scheduling data.
evidence: MSP backup job report; vendor terms; platform SOC 2 report

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; scheduling platform vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: Every staff member and contractor tutor has a named account in each service; no shared logins.

provider_if_inherited: Productivity suite vendor; tutoring platform vendor; MSP
implementation_statement: MFA is enforced for every suite account. Gaps: MFA is available but not enforced in the tutoring platform (including its 4 administrator accounts); the scheduling platform administrator login, the backup console, and the firewall management login use a password only.
evidence: Suite MFA report; platform security settings

implementation_statement: Vendor password rules apply in each SaaS service. Gaps: the staff Wi-Fi password has not changed since 2023; there is no rule against reusing personal passwords.
POL-03 Incident Response Policy approved 2026-08-28, effective 2026-09-01.

No incident handling capability before this engagement. The P08 ransomware runbook (approved 2026-08-28) assigns the MSP technical response and the insurer's panel for counsel and forensics. First tabletop due 2026-11-30.

No reporting rule existed. POL-03 4.2 requires staff and contractor tutors to report at once (within 1 hour). The district's 48-hour notice term and the Florida deadlines are in the P08 notification matrix.
P08 runbook approved 2026-08-28; not yet tested; printed copy at the front desk.
The MSP wipes returned laptops. Gap: no disposal records; two laptops retired in 2025 have no wipe record; paper intake forms go in a regular recycling bin.
The center is locked outside opening hours with an alarm; keys are held by the Owner, Center Director, and Director of Tutoring. The office and network closet are locked.
This SSP (P02) is the first plan; it forms part of the written information security program with the P06 policies.

Staff sign the employee handbook, which has a short confidentiality clause. Gap: contractor tutors sign no rules of behavior. POL-02 Part C sets workforce use rules; signed acknowledgments from staff and contractor tutors are due 2026-09-30.
The Owner designated the Center Director in writing as Information Security Coordinator on 2026-07-13 (16 CFR 312.8(b)(1)).
Every employee and contractor tutor is background-screened before working with students; results are kept in the HR folder.
Departing staff hand back keys and laptops. Gap: no checklist; accounts are removed when someone remembers (three former contractor tutors kept platform access).

Contractor tutors are screened and trained in child safety. Gap: the contractor agreement has no confidentiality, security, device, or incident reporting terms. A new agreement template is due 2026-09-30.

Parents tick a privacy check box in the online enrollment agreement and pay the enrollment fee by card. Gaps: the direct notice lacks the 312.4(c)(1) content; there is no separate consent for disclosures that are not integral to the service (312.5(a)(2)); trial accounts are created for prospective students before consent; district students rely on the district's authorization without a written record of its scope.
evidence: Enrollment agreement; consent records in SYS-02

implementation_statement: A generic privacy notice is posted on the website (SYS-08). Gap: it does not list the platform vendor and other third parties, the retention policy, or how parents can review and delete information (312.4(d)); there is no link in the student portal.
First risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 (P01). POL-02 A.2 requires an update every July and after material changes (312.8(b)(2)).

Vendors were chosen on features and price. Gaps: no written security assurances from the platform or scheduling vendor (312.8(c)); the platform's data processing addendum is unsigned; the platform SOC 2 report was first requested in July 2026; the MSP contract has no security terms.

A small-business firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic. Gaps: student and guest devices share the staff network segment; the firewall management page was reachable from the internet with a password only (found in P07 testing and turned off 2026-08-06).

provider_if_inherited: Tutoring platform vendor; scheduling platform vendor; productivity suite vendor
implementation_statement: Every SaaS service uses TLS; online classroom media is encrypted in transit (platform SOC 2 report). Email to parents and the district is sent through the suite with TLS.
The SaaS vendors encrypt stored data; the MSP enabled full-disk encryption on the 7 laptops. Gaps: the front-desk desktop is not encrypted; contractor tutors' computers are unknown.
The MSP patches company laptops and the desktop monthly and the firewall quarterly and reports monthly. SaaS vendors patch their services.
MSP-managed signature antivirus on company laptops and the desktop. Gaps: no behavior-based detection; alerts go to an MSP mailbox checked during business hours only.
No monitoring. Suite alerts for mass downloads, new forwarding rules, and risky sign-ins, and MSP-managed EDR, are planned for 2026-12-31.

No retention rules: the platform keeps about 1,900 former students' records and every online session recording since 2019. POL-04 4.9 (approved 2026-08-28) sets a written retention schedule; first purge due 2026-11-30.
